q: Whatever is in the heavens and on earth glorify Allaah
(even though man may not perceive this).
All kingdom and all praise belong to Him and He has power over all things.
v.s: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting God. To Him belongs dominion, and to Him belongs [all] praise, and He is over all things competent.
v.c: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth ˹constantly˺ glorifies Allah. The kingdom is His, and all praise is for Him. For He is Most Capable of everything.

q: It is He Who created you,
(and showed you the paths of Imaan and kufr)
so among you are Mu'min and among you are Kaafir.
Allaah is Watchful over what you do
(and will take you to task for the wrong you do).
v.s: It is He who created you, and among you is the disbeliever, and among you is the believer. And God, of what you do, is Seeing.
v.c: He is the One Who created you, yet some of you are disbelievers while some are believers. And Allah is All-Seeing of what you do.

q: He has created the heavens and the earth with the truth
fashioned you and beautified your appearance
(making you look better than other creation).
v.s: He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the [final] destination.
v.c: He created the heavens and the earth for a purpose. He shaped you ˹in the womb˺, perfecting your form. And to Him is the final return.

q: He knows what is in the heavens and the earth, He knows what you keep secret
(He knows your beliefs and your motives, so monitor them regularly.)
v.s: He knows what is within the heavens and earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare. And God is Knowing of that within the breasts.
v.c: He knows whatever is in the heavens and the earth. And He knows whatever you conceal and whatever you reveal. For Allah knows best what is ˹hidden˺ in the heart.

q: not reached you? They tasted the evil consequences
of their affairs and theirs shall be a painful punishment
v.s: Has there not come to you the news of those who disbelieved before? So they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment.
v.c: Have the stories of those who disbelieved before not reached you ˹pagans˺? They tasted the evil consequences of their doings, and they will suffer a painful punishment.

q: because their Rusul came to them with clear signs
guide us?” So they committed kufr and turned away
(from the message of their Ambiyaa). (Their attitude did not harm Allaah at all because)
Allaah had no need of them. Allaah is Independent
(not in need of anyone or) anything),
(always deserves praise even if the Kuffaar refuse to praise Him).
v.s: That is because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences, but they said, "Shall human beings guide us?" and disbelieved and turned away. And God dispensed [with them]; and God is Free of need and Praiseworthy.
v.c: That was because their messengers used to come to them with clear proofs, but they said ˹mockingly˺, “How can humans be our guides?” So they persisted in disbelief and turned away. And Allah was not in need ˹of their faith˺. For Allah is Self-Sufficient, Praiseworthy.

q: The Kuffaar think that they will never be resurrected
Tell them, “Definitely by the oath of my Rabb! You will certainly
be resurrected and then you will be informed
of what you did. This is very simple
v.s: Those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected. Say, "Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected; then you will surely be informed of what you did. And that, for God, is easy."
v.c: The disbelievers claim they will not be resurrected. Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected, then you will certainly be informed of what you have done. And that is easy for Allah.”

q: So believe in Allaah, in His Rasool ﷺ and in the light
that He revealed. Allaah is Informed of what you do.
v.s: So believe in God and His Messenger and the light [i.e., the Qur’ān] which We have sent down. And God is Acquainted with what you do.
v.c: So believe in Allah and His Messenger and in the Light We have revealed. And Allah is All-Aware of what you do.

q: when He will gather you for the day of gathering, that Will be the day of great loss
(for the Kuffaar who will lose the privilege of entering Jannah). (As for)
The one who believes in Allaah and carries out good deeds, Allaah shall cancel
his sins and enter him into Jannaat beneath which rivers flow. He shall live there forever. That is the great success.
v.s: The Day He will assemble you for the Day of Assembly - that is the Day of Deprivation. And whoever believes in God and does righteousness - He will remove from him his misdeeds and admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. That is the great attainment.
v.c: ˹Consider˺ the Day He will gather you ˹all˺ for the Day of Gathering—that will be the Day of mutual loss and gain. So whoever believes in Allah and does good, He will absolve them of their sins and admit them into Gardens under which rivers flow, to stay there for ever and ever. That is the ultimate triumph.

q: Those who commit kufr and reject Our Aayaat are the inhabitants of the Fire
in which they shall live forever. It
is the worst of places to return to
(especially for people who had been enjoying the pleasures of this world).
v.s: But the ones who disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of the Fire, abiding eternally therein; and wretched is the destination.
v.c: As for those who disbelieve and reject Our revelations, they will be the residents of the Fire, staying there forever. What an evil destination!

q: Every calamity befalls you only by Allaah's command.
(He allows these calamities to befall you for good reason, so that you may bear them with patience.)
Allaah guides the heart of the one who believes in Him
(thus enabling him to bear calamities with patience)
and Allaah has knowledge of everything.
(He knows how much every person can bear and who are the ones who exercise patience.)
v.s: No disaster strikes except by permission of God. And whoever believes in God - He will guide his heart. And God is Knowing of all things.
v.c: No calamity befalls ˹anyone˺ except by Allah’s Will. And whoever has faith in Allah, He will ˹rightly˺ guide their hearts ˹through adversity˺. And Allah has ˹perfect˺ knowledge of all things.

q: Obey Allaah and obey the Rasool ﷺ. If you turn away
of the Rasool ﷺ is only clear propagation.
(He is not expected to force you to accept Imaan and will not be harmed by your rejection. Only you will suffer the consequences of your kufr.)
v.s: And obey God and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon Our Messenger is only [the duty of] clear notification.
v.c: Obey Allah and obey the Messenger! But if you turn away, then Our Messenger’s duty is only to deliver ˹the message˺ clearly.

q: Allaah, there is no Ilaah but He.
Only in Allaah should the Mu'mineen trust.
v.s: God - there is no deity except Him. And upon God let the believers rely.
v.c: Allah—there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. So in Allah let the believers put their trust.

q: O you who have Imaan! You have enemies among your spouses and children
(who may intentionally or unintentionally cause you to neglect your duties to Allaah)
(by never allowing your love for them to take precedence over your duties to Allaah). (However,)
If you pardon, overlook and forgive
(them when their requests anger you for good reason),
Allaah is certainly Most Forgiving, Most Merciful
v.s: O you who have believed, indeed, among your wives and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon and overlook and forgive - then indeed, God is Forgiving and Merciful.
v.c: O believers! Indeed, some of your spouses and children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon, overlook, and forgive ˹their faults˺, then Allah is truly All-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
v.h: The Test of Family and Wealth

q: Your wealth and children are merely a test
(to ascertain whether you will allow them to distract you from worshipping Allaah). (When such times of test arrive, remember that)
(for those who fulfil their duties to Allaah despite the distractions that their wealth and children present).
v.s: Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and God has with Him a great reward.
v.c: Your wealth and children are only a test, but Allah ˹alone˺ has a great reward.

q: Allaah as much as you can
This is best for you. Those who are protected
of their souls are indeed the successful ones
(because they are free to be charitable).
v.s: So fear God as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend [in the way of God]; it is better for your selves. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.
v.c: So be mindful of Allah to the best of your ability, hear and obey, and spend in charity—that will be best for you. And whoever is saved from the selfishness of their own souls, it is they who are ˹truly˺ successful.

q: If you lend to Allaah a beautiful loan
(by spending in charity for His pleasure),
your rewards and forgive you. Allaah is Appreciative
(of every good deed, regardless of how small it may seem),
v.s: If you loan God a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. And God is [most] Appreciative and Forbearing,
v.c: If you lend to Allah a good loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. For Allah is Most Appreciative, Most Forbearing.

q: ...Knower of the unseen and the seen, the Mighty, the Wise.
v.s: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
v.c: ˹He is the˺ Knower of the seen and unseen—the Almighty, All-Wise.
